## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
ROTATION, Growth/Momentum style. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive; confirmation: broad sector breadth plus rotation of flows as Financials and Materials lead while Tech shows mixed internals.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Financials lead: JPM (1W: +4.76% | 1M: +8.22%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +6.73% | 1M: +19.03%) ABOVE TREND, MS (1W: +5.15% | 1M: +9.94%) ABOVE TREND. Materials strong: FCX (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +29.15%) ABOVE TREND. Technology strong but concentrated: NVDA (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +0.49%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Consumer Discretionary weak: TSLA (1W: -1.69% | 1M: +13.30%) CORRECTION, NKE (1W: -7.16% | 1M: -3.71%) BELOW TREND, MCD (1W: -2.81% | 1M: +0.67%) CORRECTION. Consumer Staples weak: PEP (1W: -3.74% | 1M: -0.63%) BELOW TREND, KHC (1W: -2.51% | 1M: -3.64%) BELOW TREND, WMT (1W: -2.69% | 1M: +4.64%) CORRECTION. Utilities under pressure (1W: -0.66% | 1M: -3.98%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: FCX (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +29.15%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +0.49%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +6.95% | 1M: -8.37%) RECOVERY, AMD (1W: +6.93% | 1M: +4.30%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: TSLA (1W: -1.69% | 1M: +13.30%) CORRECTION, MET (1W: -1.73% | 1M: +6.02%) CORRECTION, MDT (1W: -1.99% | 1M: -8.38%) BELOW TREND, CMCSA (1W: -2.02% | 1M: +11.17%) CORRECTION, KHC (1W: -2.51% | 1M: -3.64%) BELOW TREND.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Best 1W momentum: FCX (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +29.15%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +0.49%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND; watch AVGO (1W: +6.95% | 1M: -8.37%) RECOVERY for a short-term reversal. Note MAJOR DIVERGENCE among Big Tech: AAPL, GOOGL and META showing mixed 1W vs 1M signals — watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed but still leadership-concentrated: NVDA (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +0.49%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +6.93% | 1M: +4.30%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +6.95% | 1M: -8.37%) RECOVERY; pockets of RECOVERY and CORRECTION among mega-cap names. Sector breadth: Tech 13/19 positive.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Broad strength and confirmation of rotation into cyclicals: JPM (1W: +4.76% | 1M: +8.22%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +6.73% | 1M: +19.03%) ABOVE TREND, MS (1W: +5.15% | 1M: +9.94%) ABOVE TREND. Sector breadth: Financials 16/20 positive.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Mixed with selective winners: MRK (1W: +6.05% | 1M: +1.92%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +1.12% | 1M: +2.38%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +1.97% | 1M: -2.90%) RECOVERY while MDT (1W: -1.99% | 1M: -8.38%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Healthcare 10/15 positive.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor Financials and Materials exposure (JPM (1W: +4.76% | 1M: +8.22%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +6.73% | 1M: +19.03%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +29.15%) ABOVE TREND) and monitor concentrated Tech leaders; reduce exposure to stretched Consumer Discretionary and selective lagging staples (NKE (1W: -7.16% | 1M: -3.71%) BELOW TREND, SBUX (1W: -4.85% | 1M: -0.97%) BELOW TREND).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: NVDA (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +0.49%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +6.73% | 1M: +19.03%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: KHC (1W: -2.51% | 1M: -3.64%) BELOW TREND, MDT (1W: -1.99% | 1M: -8.38%) BELOW TREND, NKE (1W: -7.16% | 1M: -3.71%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Financials (breadth strong, 16/20 positive) and Materials (FCX leading). BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary (several names in CORRECTION/BOTTOM) and Utilities (continuing weakness).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA: test near major resistance (round-number area) for continuation of ABOVE TREND strength; ORCL: confirm breakout follow-through after strong 1W surge; JPM: watch continuation above recent highs to validate Financials leadership; FCX: hold near support-turned-base to confirm Materials leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
ORCL (+45): Phillip Securities capex upgrade — ORCL (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +0.49%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed by price. XOM (+50): 2030 outlook raised — XOM (1W: +2.21% | 1M: +4.02%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed. C (+50): regulatory relief / turnaround headlines — C (1W: +6.73% | 1M: +19.03%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
BA (-40): China/defense headlines — BA (1W: +3.92% | 1M: +18.64%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment diverging (price rising). HD (-40): negative coverage — HD (1W: -1.47% | 1M: +0.28%) CORRECTION, sentiment aligned with short-term weakness. KHC (-45): mixed headlines and guidance concern — KHC (1W: -2.51% | 1M: -3.64%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION, Growth/Momentum style; Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive and leadership is Narrow (4/5 Technology in Top 5). NVDA (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +6.73% | 1M: +19.03%) ABOVE TREND and FCX (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +29.15%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is major divergence among Big Tech — AAPL (1W: +0.44% | 1M: -1.29%) RECOVERY, GOOGL (1W: +3.65% | 1M: -3.01%) RECOVERY, META (1W: -0.17% | 1M: +4.34%) CORRECTION — watch for trend confirmations and sentiment mismatches.
